contentList.content: You can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ImprovedMinorIllusion">Improved Minor Illusion</LSTag> using a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>.

When you <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Help">Help</LSTag> an ally or take a similar action, you will gain a new <LSTag Tooltip="PortentDice">Portent Die</LSTag> on your next <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>.
